result.explanation: Maintain an opaque controller state. Only the mounted, loading request matching the current ID may settle; a new search cancels the prior request first. Disposal resets data and unmounts, while mount restores the initial mounted state.
result.mapping: The current ID is the causal identity of the active request; query/result/error/loading are retained or replaced exactly as specified, and effects record only cancellation and request actions from the current event.
result.assumptions: Events are legal JSON objects under the stated contract. Unknown events are no-ops while mounted and all non-mount events are no-ops while disposed.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const x of output){if(!x||typeof x!=="object"||Array.isArray(x))return false;for(const k of ["mounted","query","current","loading","result","error","effects"])if(!(k in x))return false;if(Object.keys(x).length!==7||!Array.isArray(x.effects))return false}return true}
